title: Canonical transport of scheme points
statement: Let T be a scheme, E a sheaf of sets on its small etale site, U an etale T-scheme, Q a finite etale U-scheme, and e an isomorphism from E restricted to the localized site at U to the lifted Yoneda presheaf of Q. Let c be the universal comparison point [def-weil-pbc-finite-local-model-comparison-point] on R = Q times_T U. For any scheme W, maps a,b from W to U with equal composites to T, and a map x from W to Q satisfying x composed with Q to U equals a, define transport of x over b as the composite of the pullback lift (x,b): W to R with c: R to Q.

source.place: Tags 03RV and 02W5; universal-point form of the Yoneda comparison
